Over a 50-year time period ... more than half of the apple orchards in Japan utilized this species";"In 1977, O. cornifrons was introduced in the northeastern United States";"females will create individual cells in which they lay a single egg ... closes off the cell with mud";"Eggs are placed on top of the pollen ball"。未提及体长、未提及中西部定殖、未解释 mason bee 名称来源。

抓取成功,页面为 Osmia cornifrons | Exotic Bee ID 事实表。关键原句:"Osmia cornifrons is a solitary bee that nests in preexisting cavities";"native to eastern Asia and has been found in Japan and Korea as well as the southeast coast of Russia";"intentionally introduced to the eastern U.S. from Japan in the 1970s";"In the U.S., O. cornifrons can be found on the East Coast and the Midwest";"Nests cells are constructed of mud and leaf pulp";"Female body length ranges from 8–12 mm, and male body length ranges from 8–10 mm"。未提及日本苹果园百分比。

抓取成功。关键原句:"Mason bees are named for their habit of using mud or other 'masonry' products in constructing their nests";"Osmia species are solitary; every female is fertile and makes her own nest, and no worker bees for these species exist";"Once a provision mass is complete, the bee backs into the hole and lays an egg on top of the mass. Then, she creates a partition of 'mud', which doubles as the back of the next cell";提到 "the hornfaced bee O. cornifrons" 为商业授粉蜂,但未提日本/美国细节。

抓取成功。关键原句:"the eastern honey bee, Asiatic honey bee or Asian honey bee";"of the Apidae family";"native to South, Southeast and East Asia";亚种表列出 "Apis cerana cerana Fabricius (= sinensis) (Chinese honey bee)" 等 8 个亚种;"known for its highly social behavior";"colony ... consists of several thousand female worker bees, one queen bee, and several hundred male drone bees";"builds nests consisting of multiple combs in cavities";"nest itself is a simple vertical comb made from wax";"both are medium-sized bees (10-11mm)";"Adult Apis cerana are black in color, with four yellow abdominal stripes";"about 500 Japanese honey bees ... surround the hornet and vibrate their flight muscles until the temperature is raised to 47 °C (117 °F), heating the hornet to death, but keeping the temperature still under their own lethal limit (48–50 °C)"。未提及"传统饲养/主要蜂种"、未提及色泽因亚种地区而异。

issues.claim: 据报道 1977 年前后它被引入美国东部,此后在美国东部与中西部定殖。
issues.problem: 非阻断性备注:两个来源年份粒度不同——Wikipedia 给出精确年份 1977 与"northeastern United States",idtools 事实表只说 "introduced to the eastern U.S. from Japan in the 1970s";"东部与中西部定殖"仅由 idtools 支持(Wikipedia 只提东北部)。正文已用"据报道""前后"限定,且两来源相互一致、无矛盾,判为已恰当限定。
issues.evidence: Wikipedia:"In 1977, O. cornifrons was introduced in the northeastern United States";idtools:"intentionally introduced to the eastern U.S. from Japan in the 1970s" / "In the U.S., O. cornifrons can be found on the East Coast and the Midwest"。
issues.fix: 无需修改。若希望更精确,可将"美国东部"改为"美国东北部"(与 Wikipedia 原句一致),定殖范围保留"东部与中西部"(idtools)。

issues.claim: 它用泥土在竹管或芦苇管里隔出一间间巢室,每室放一个花粉球和一枚卵。
issues.problem: 非阻断性备注:"每室一个花粉球和一枚卵"由 Wikipedia Osmia cornifrons 页("individual cells in which they lay a single egg"、"Eggs are placed on top of the pollen ball")与 Mason bee 页支持;idtools 补充巢室材料为 "mud and leaf pulp"(泥与叶浆),正文只写"泥土"属于简化而非错误。"竹管或芦苇管"来源表述为 "preexisting cavities"/"hollow twigs"/"tubular cavities",竹管、芦苇管是人工饲养中常见的管材举例,与来源不冲突。
issues.evidence: idtools:"Nests cells are constructed of mud and leaf pulp";Mason bee:"Osmia females typically nest in narrow gaps and naturally occurring tubular cavities ... she creates a partition of 'mud', which doubles as the back of the next cell"。
issues.fix: 无需修改。可选:将"用泥土"改为"用泥土(有时掺叶浆)",或将"竹管或芦苇管"改为"竹管、芦苇管等现成管状孔洞",以贴近来源。

issues.claim: 面对胡蜂等天敌时,会用蜂团把对方围住、使其过热致死(热球防御)。
issues.problem: 非阻断性备注:两个来源对热球防御的描述均以日本亚种为例(Apis cerana 页写 "Japanese honey bees" 加热至 47 °C;Honey bee 页明确写 "In Apis cerana japonica")。来源未否定其他亚种具备该行为,该行为出现在物种条目的防御段落中,故判为支持;但若要严格贴合来源,可注明记录最详的是日本亚种。
issues.evidence: Apis cerana:"about 500 Japanese honey bees ... surround the hornet and vibrate their flight muscles until the temperature is raised to 47 °C (117 °F), heating the hornet to death";Honey bee:"In Apis cerana japonica, defense against larger insects such as predatory wasps ... is usually performed by surrounding the intruder"。
issues.fix: 可选:改为"面对胡蜂等天敌时,会用蜂团把对方围住、使其过热致死(热球防御,以日本亚种的记录最为详尽,蜂团中心约 47 °C)"。

issues.claim: 中华蜜蜂(Apis cerana cerana)是它在中国最主要的亚种;长期是当地传统养蜂的主要蜂种。
issues.problem: 非阻断性备注:"A. c. cerana = Chinese honey bee"由 Apis cerana 页亚种表支持;"传统饲养蜂种"由 Honey bee 页 "the traditional honey bee of southern and eastern Asia" 支持。"最主要""长期"两处来源未直接量化,但已在限定词清单内,按已恰当限定处理。
issues.evidence: Apis cerana:"Apis cerana cerana Fabricius (= sinensis) (Chinese honey bee)";Honey bee:"Apis cerana, the eastern honey bee proper, is the traditional honey bee of southern and eastern Asia"。

issues.claim: 工蜂体长约 10–11 mm(不同资料约 9–12 mm);常描述为四条黄纹,色泽因亚种与地区而异。
issues.problem: 非阻断性备注:10–11 mm 与 "four yellow abdominal stripes" 均被 Apis cerana 页原句支持,数字一致;"不同资料约 9–12 mm"与"因亚种与地区而异"来源未提及,但已用限定词,按已恰当限定处理。
issues.evidence: Apis cerana:"both are medium-sized bees (10-11mm)";"Adult Apis cerana are black in color, with four yellow abdominal stripes"。
